environment.counter_scope: libproc RUSAGE_INFO_V4 per-process; energy fields are raw OS counters, not watts
environment.window_activation_scope: request foreground for the owned child at active/churn begin; repaint activity remains mandatory
environment.native_geometry_scope: actual client viewport and scale at each phase begin/end; stable and equal across all captures required
environment.timing_scope: CPU draw and platform submission when enabled; common application callback timing always enabled; no GPU/compositor completion measurement

derivation.sample_selection: For each run and each of idle-before/active/idle-after/churn, retain the original collector stable samples [1:-1]. Exclude startup, warmup, oracle validation, and phase boundary samples.
derivation.cpu_percent: Recompute cumulative (user_ns + system_ns) delta / stable elapsed seconds / 1e7 per phase, then report the median of the five per-run percentages. 100% means one CPU core, not all three runner cores.
derivation.stable_sampled_peak_rss_bytes: Maximum rss_bytes among the retained stable samples across all four measured phases per run, then median across the five captures. A sampled peak, not an exact lifetime RSS high-water mark.
derivation.draw_cpu_us_p99: Use the exact frozen collector quantile: sorted(draw_cpu_us)[int((n - 1) * .99)], then median of the five per-run p99 values. No pooled or interpolated p99. Timing-disabled results are null.
derivation.submission_cpu_us_p99: Same per-run quantile then median convention as draw. Platform submission spans exclude GPU/compositor completion.

limitations: Historical hosted source e219439 and declared GPUI Kit0.7.0 revision3467e647; not current Kael HEAD and not the latest comparator release. Later changes are excluded.

One shared hosted virtual macOS runner. Exact CPU/memory metadata is preserved below. Five alternating repetitions per engine are descriptive within each fixed contract/mode, not an overall framework ranking or controlled bare-metal power comparison.
Actual phase-boundary geometry is derived below from the raw reports; nominal1100x760 fixture metadata alone is not geometry proof.

The display inventory is empty. Accepted owned foreground requests and mandatory active/churn repaint gates were verified; this is not independent proof of foreground focus, native monitor presentation, GPU completion, compositor latency, or visible smoothness.
CPU draw/submission durations are CPU-side wall-clock spans recorded with optional instrumentation, not GPU time or end-to-end latency. Timing-enabled and timing-disabled builds are kept separate.
Stable sampled RSS excludes startup and oracle validation, and is process RSS rather than retained heap, allocator usage, GPU residency, or an exact high-water mark.
Startup timings lack matched initial geometry and are not summarized as comparative results.
Application executable bytes were uploaded and independently rehashed against every capture. This verifies binary identity, not visible compositor presentation or GPU time.
Unavailable/zero-only counters are reported explicitly from this run and are not converted to watts or used to rank energy efficiency.

The fixed phase schedule and original operation-coverage gates do not guarantee equal operation counts across captures or engines. Actual per-run counts and native component differences are retained; modes are not a controlled instrumentation-overhead experiment.

Native component contracts preserve documented differences such as data-header height, tree accessibility metadata scope and dock chrome. Passing the original oracle/geometry gates does not establish pixel-identical rendering or complete feature parity.
